developer_response.body:
Sorry you couldn't get in during the Playtest! We had a ton of players trying to join at once, but things have gotten better since then.

As a little make-up gift, use code MECHUP at the in-game Gift Code machine during today's Playtest to grab 1,000 Mechite. Really appreciate your patience and support!

reviews.review_description: This is actually the best game I have ever played. I’ve played probably hundreds of games, reviewed them, and played them again. This game is NEEDED if you want to have fun in your life. This game has the best physics, best combat in any game, and has the greatest community of all time. Keep in mind that as I’m typing this there isn’t a SINGLE bad review. This actually the best game I’ve ever seen, heard, smelled, and tasted. This is the best game ever.
